scope: Offline checking of native Studio evaluation report JSON, explicit browser download, existing authenticated GET route unchanged. No external provider or VM use.
proof: Actual Studio experiment with a synthetic provider produced a report accepted by both the CLI and thin example; neither consumer changed the file or invoked more tasks.
Per-variant threshold recomputation, stronger override, incomplete/error evidence, duplicate slots/fields, malformed checks, file bounds and CLI exit statuses exercised.
Browser logic verifies explicit export, authenticated GET selection, escaped identity, no automatic download and no download after authorization/transport failure.
Existing experiment continuation, scoped HTTP report access and CLI compatibility pass.
limits: A local report is not signed; this gate establishes consistency and thresholds, not authenticity or model quality.
No before/after regression comparison or automatic deployment.
Browser checks are Node-based logic tests, not real-device or visual browser acceptance.
Frozen inventory counts are unchanged; new comparison candidates are separate.
migration: None; persisted records, routes and request formats unchanged.
